concern: (low) Ensure touch target areas for top navigation links meet 44x44px on compact 375px mobile viewports.
jtbd: When navigating the application on a compact 375px mobile viewport, I want the top navigation links to have a touch target area of at least 44x44px, so that I can accurately and reliably activate navigation items without mis-tapping adjacent links.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a compact mobile viewport of 375px width, When the top navigation links in the header are evaluated for touch target size, Then each navigation link interactive area measures at least 44px by 44px in both width and height.
editInstruction: In `design/approved/20261117154026-mockup/mockup.html`, locate the `<nav role="navigation" aria-label="Main Navigation">` element inside `<header>`. On each navigation `<a>` link, replace the `p-1` class with `inline-flex items-center justify-center min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] px-3 py-2.5` to ensure touch targets meet the minimum 44x44px area on 375px viewports without altering desktop visual alignment or existing focus rings.

concern: (low) Form inputs could benefit from explicit aria-describedby helper text to provide further cognitive affordance.
jtbd: When interacting with the form inputs, I want explicit helper text connected via aria-describedby, so that I receive additional cognitive affordance and guidance on the expected input requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the form inputs on the page, When an assistive technology or user focuses on each input element, Then each input has an aria-describedby attribute referencing an existing helper text element describing the input requirements.
